description: This PHP source file defines the AttendanceRecordSearchFilterParams class within the OrangeHRM project. It extends FilterParams to encapsulate search filter parameters specific to attendance records, such as employee numbers and date ranges. The class sets default sorting and provides getters and setters for its properties.

classes.name: AttendanceRecordSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class that extends FilterParams to specify filtering criteria for attendance record searches, including employee IDs and date range filters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sorting field and order, and may throw a SearchParamException.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Returns the list of employee numbers used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Sets the list of employee numbers used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Retrieves the start date for the attendance record search filter.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for the attendance record search filter.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Retrieves the end date for the attendance record search filter.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for the attendance record search filter.
